text:
sara: FYI Acme reporting spike of 401s + intermittent 503s since libcrypto update last night. Customer says it's blocking payment flows, marked P1. Raising for triage and patch ETA.

alex-oncall: Ack, I'm on it. Tagging infra + security. Can we get repro and exact package version? @devon-infra @maria-security

devon-infra: Looking at our deploy logs: libcrypto 3.2.1-rc1 rolled to dedicated pool at 2026-03-15T23:10Z. No automatic rollback triggered. Can repro on a repro harness with customer key material.

raj-support: Customer repro steps (from support ticket):
```
# repro
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"ping"}' \
  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate
# sometimes returns 401, sometimes 503
```
They also attached logs showing HSM key lookup failures: "keystore: decrypt failed: ERR_LIB_CRYPTO:0x8"

maria-security: This looks similar to an interim CVE we tracked (CVE-2026-1384) that affects libcrypto key unwrap on certain HSM drivers. Need to confirm but treat as potentially security-sensitive.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-345 created, severity: P1, pager duty notified.

alex-oncall: Repro confirmed in staging when we use customer-wrapped keys and the 3.2.1-rc1 build. Error stack: `EVP_DecryptFinal_ex -> CRYPTO_gcm_finalize -> ERR_LIB_CRYPTO`. Rolling back packages on the affected pool now.

devon-infra: Rollback started at 2026-03-16T00:05Z. Expected completion ~10m. Noted a small percentage of nodes still on 3.2.1-rc1 due to long-lived sessions.

june-cs: Customer (Acme) wants an ETA for a security patch and a mitigation plan. They need confirmation that rolling back will restore service and whether any data was exposed.

maria-security: Immediate mitigation: rollback to stable libcrypto 3.1.4 (in progress). Short-term workaround for customers who can't tolerate rollback: enable software crypto fallback (disables HSM acceleration) per account until HSM driver patch is available. Need legal/ps to be aware.

alex-oncall: Confirming rollback restored successful auths for our repro harness. Patch ETA: security team to coordinate with upstream OpenSSL and HSM vendor; rough ETA 24-48 hours for a vendor-provided patch and 4-6 hours internal validation and staged deploy if vendor patch drops. If vendor delays, we publish advisory and keep rollback + software-fallback as supported mitigations.

raj-support: Communicating to Acme: rollback in progress, we expect service restored within 15m for most traffic. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with timeline for a patched libcrypto/hsm driver. Customer requested SLA impact and whether billing will be adjusted.

maria-security: Action items: 1) Security to confirm CVE linkage or rule it out (maria-security). 2) Vendor contact to get patch ETA (maria-security). 3) Expand rollback to all affected clusters (devon-infra). 4) Create KB for software-fallback and CS playbook (raj-support + june-cs). 5) Draft advisory language (alex-oncall).

sara: Thanks. Prioritize communication cadence: update customer in 30m, then hourly until resolved. If vendor patch ETA >24h, escalate to legal + exec.

alex-oncall: I'll post back with rollback completion and initial impact numbers.

devon-infra: Rollback completed across 90% of nodes at 2026-03-16T00:18Z. Observed drop in 401/503 counts to near baseline in telemetry. Leaving a small canary group on 3.2.1-rc1 to validate hotfix behavior.

maria-security: Opening a security advisory draft now. If we confirm CVE, coordinate disclosure timeline with vendor and CISO.

raj-support: Customer updated: service recovering, asked for incident timeline + whether any credentials were exfiltrated. We told them no evidence of exfil but we will share post-incident findings.

alex-oncall: Closing loop for now. If we see regression we'll re-open. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
